job.title: Software Engineer, Notifications
job.workplace: In office Tuesday–Thursday (Monday and Friday optional)
job.pay_full: $153,120 – $196,750 a year starting base pay (San Mateo headquarters), plus eligibility for equity compensation

details.about: Every day, tens of millions of people use Roblox to explore, create, play, learn and connect in 3D immersive experiences built by its global community of creators. The Notifications team builds and runs the systems that deliver timely, relevant notifications to millions of Roblox users across push, in-app stream, email and toast. Engineers design, ship and measure their own features with product, design, data science and ML partners.
duties: Build and scale the pipeline that routes and delivers notifications across channels, including onboarding new notification types for teams across Roblox
Ship and iterate on recommended notifications: candidate expansion, ranking and filtering, and presentation
Run and analyse A/B experiments to improve reachability, engagement and long-term retention
Contribute to developer-facing notification APIs and operational excellence, including observability and on-call
needs: Experience building backend or full-stack services
Experience with distributed systems or large-scale data pipelines
An analytical mindset and the ability to use data to understand the impact of your work
Respect for teammates and commitment to a collaborative, inclusive environment
details.benefits: Starting base pay $153,120 – $196,750 a year for roles at the San Mateo, CA headquarters; actual pay depends on background, experience, location and market factors and can fall outside the range. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and benefits.
notes: Office-based roles are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday
Roblox may not be able to employ candidates whose US work authorization depends on certain visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship, for this role
